description: scripts/verify-release-evidence.mjs, which the verify job of release.yml runs on the evidence of the sharded Hub run before anything is published (docs/RELEASING.md): which folders count as a shard, what a shard says about its commit, system, split and length, that every result is PASS with exit code 0 and every other count is 0, that each suite of the list ran exactly once and no other did, that the log agrees with the summary, and the command line; judged by tests/verify-release-evidence.mjs on evidence the real runner wrote.

mutations.name: RE-missing-shard-accepted
mutations.what: a shard without evidence is passed over

patches.old: if (found.length === 0) { problems.push(`shard ${index}: its evidence is missing`); continue; }

mutations.name: RE-second-folder-ignored
mutations.what: a second folder of a shard is not noticed

mutations.name: RE-extra-shard-ignored
mutations.what: a shard above the count is passed over

patches.old: else if (index > shards) problems.push(`${entry.name}: a release run of ${shards} shards has no shard ${index}`);

mutations.name: RE-stray-folder-ignored
mutations.what: a folder that is no shard is passed over

mutations.name: RE-unreadable-folder-accepted
mutations.what: a folder that cannot be read is no problem

patches.old: return { problems: [`${directory} could not be read: ${error.message}`], shards: [] };

mutations.name: RE-last-shard-not-read
mutations.what: the loop over the shards stops one short

mutations.name: RE-commit-not-compared
mutations.what: evidence of another commit is accepted

mutations.name: RE-empty-commit-accepted
mutations.what: an empty commit file is accepted

mutations.name: RE-missing-file-accepted
mutations.what: a file that cannot be read is no problem

patches.old: catch (error) { say(`${name} could not be read: ${error.message}`); return null; }

mutations.name: RE-broken-json-accepted
mutations.what: a summary that is not JSON is passed over

patches.old: catch (error) { say(`node-summary.json could not be read: ${error.message}`); }

mutations.name: RE-other-json-accepted
mutations.what: JSON that is no summary is passed over

patches.old: { say('node-summary.json is not a summary of run-all.mjs'); parsed = null; }

mutations.name: RE-result-shape-unchecked
mutations.what: a result that is not an object with a name counts as a summary

mutations.name: RE-unsharded-accepted
mutations.what: a run without --shard is accepted

patches.old: if (!shard) say(`the summary says no shard, not ${index}/${shards}`);

mutations.name: RE-shard-number-unchecked
mutations.what: the number of the shard is not compared with its folder

mutations.name: RE-shard-count-unchecked
mutations.what: the number of shards of the split is not compared

mutations.name: RE-list-length-unchecked
mutations.what: a split of another list is accepted

mutations.name: RE-cut-short-accepted
mutations.what: a shard that ran fewer suites than it holds is accepted

mutations.name: RE-platform-unchecked
mutations.what: a run on another system is accepted

mutations.name: RE-flaky-result-accepted
mutations.what: a suite that passed on a retry counts as passed

mutations.name: RE-skip-result-accepted
mutations.what: a skipped suite counts as passed

mutations.name: RE-timeout-result-accepted
mutations.what: a suite that timed out counts as passed

mutations.name: RE-exit-code-unchecked
mutations.what: a PASS with another exit code is accepted

mutations.name: RE-null-exit-code-accepted
mutations.what: a PASS without an exit code is accepted

mutations.name: RE-skip-count-unchecked
mutations.what: the count of skips is not looked at

mutations.name: RE-flaky-count-unchecked
mutations.what: the count of flaky suites is not looked at

mutations.name: RE-fail-count-unchecked
mutations.what: the count of failures is not looked at

mutations.name: RE-timeout-count-unchecked
mutations.what: the count of time-outs is not looked at

mutations.name: RE-missing-count-accepted
mutations.what: a summary without a count is accepted

mutations.name: RE-pass-count-unchecked
mutations.what: the count of passes is not compared with the results

mutations.name: RE-total-count-unchecked
mutations.what: the total is not compared with the results

mutations.name: RE-log-list-unchecked
mutations.what: the log may list other suites than the summary

mutations.name: RE-log-status-unchecked
mutations.what: the statuses of the log are not compared

mutations.name: RE-log-end-unchecked

mutations.name: RE-indented-lines-count

mutations.name: RE-long-names-unread

mutations.name: RE-bom-kept

mutations.name: RE-list-of-the-shards-only

mutations.name: RE-problems-exit-0

mutations.name: RE-usage-exit-0

mutations.name: RE-unknown-option-ignored

mutations.name: RE-commit-shape-unchecked
